title: Ansel and the Gravity
author: Hazel Whitlock
blurb: Hazel Coldharbour, the last human technician on an automated relay station, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
